info.title: EchoRelay Management API
info.description:
Token-authenticated JSON API for AI agents and programmatic clients.
Every route is implicitly scoped to the project the request's API token
was minted for; a client only ever sees the single project its token
was minted for.

get.summary:
OpenAPI 3.x description of the **management API itself** — the
token-gated REST surface (`/projects`, `/lines`, `/keys`, `/billing`,
`/dlq`, …). It is generated from the routes it describes, so it cannot
fall behind them.
get.description:
Not the same document as `/openapi.json`, which exports one project's own
relay specification; this one describes the management routes themselves
and is not project-specific. Any valid management token, account- or
project-scoped, may read it — the same credential the API it describes
requires.

get.summary: List the authenticated user's projects (account-scoped, `read` scope).
get.description:
Returns every project the user owns, archived included, with an
`archived` flag. Mirrors the slug/name/url shape an agent then passes to
the project-scoped routes (with a project-scoped token).

post.summary:
Create a project for the authenticated user (account-scoped, `config`
scope). Body: `{name}`. The slug is derived + validated server-side
(format / reserved words / uniqueness). The project serves traffic as
soon as the call returns. 201 on success; 422 with an actionable message
when the account is at its plan's active-project cap — archive a project
or upgrade.

patch.summary:
Rename a project the user owns (account-scoped, `config` scope). Body:
`{name}`. Slug is never touched. 404 when the user does not own the slug.

post.summary: Archive a project the user owns (account-scoped, `config` scope).
post.description:
Reversible: the project and its slug persist and its credits are kept,
but it stops serving — callers of its address get 404 until it is
un-archived. Idempotent. 404 when the user does not own the slug; 409
when the project has archive protection enabled — lifting that is a
support action, not something this token can do.

post.summary:
Turn on archive protection for a project the user owns (account-scoped,
`config` scope). Idempotent and set-once: no route lifts it again and no
token can, so removing it is a support action.
Un-archive a project the user owns (account-scoped, `config` scope).
post.description:
It serves traffic again as soon as the call returns. Idempotent for an
already-active project. 404 when the user does not own the slug; 409 when
restoring would exceed the plan's active-project cap — archive another or
upgrade.

get.summary:
The project's billing state: which ledger it settles on (`prepaid` or
`invoiceable`),
credit balances (paid + testing), current tier, effective live RPM
(add-ons included), free-tier decay countdown, remaining allowance vs
prepaid pools, and the plan's overage rate.
get.description:
An empty balance does not mean the project cannot send: an Enterprise
account's credit fields are empty by design, live traffic is never
refused for an exhausted balance, and a free-tier project is exempt from
live credit billing outright. Only the testing pool refuses when spent.

get.summary: Catalog: the available subscription plans (Free, Pro, Scale).
Catalog: the prepaid credit packs available for top-up.
Catalog: monthly add-on subscriptions (RPM upgrades, extended retention, …).

post.summary:
Owner-only; requires a token minted with the billing scope. Subscribe to
a monthly add-on that renews until cancelled — or until the subscription
ends, after which the already-paid cycle stays active to its own end date
and stops without further charges. Requires an active
Pro/Scale subscription and a saved payment method.
post.description:
Body: `{addonKey, project?}` — `project` (a slug the owner owns) is
required for per-project add-ons (`rpm_*`).
Returns `{addonKey, project, monthlyEurCents, transactionId, activatedAt, nextRenewalAt}`.

get.summary: Owner-only; requires a token minted with the billing scope. The current subscription.

post.summary:
Owner-only; requires a token minted with the billing scope. Start a new
Pro/Scale subscription. Returns a hosted-checkout URL.

delete.summary: Owner-only; requires a token minted with the billing scope. Schedule cancellation at period end. Returns `{kind: scheduled, …}`.

patch.summary:
Owner-only; requires a token minted with the billing scope. Change the
current plan (Pro ↔ Scale or downgrade to Free).

post.summary:
Owner-only; requires a token minted with the billing scope. Preview the
dollar impact of a future change_plan call.

get.summary: Owner-only; requires a token minted with the billing scope. List active add-ons for the project owner.

delete.summary:
Owner-only; requires a token minted with the billing scope. Cancel an
active add-on. Stops future charges; the current cycle stays active
until expiry. Per-project add-ons (`rpm_*`) require the project slug
in `?project=`.

post.summary:
Resume (un-cancel) a pending-cancel add-on. Query param `project` selects the
project for per-project RPM tiers. Returns `{addonKey, project, nextRenewalAt, resumed}`.

Schedule a tier downgrade for a non-stackable add-on (e.g. RPM tiers). The
current tier stays active until the next renewal, at which point the lower tier
is charged and activated. Body: `{targetAddonKey, project?}`. Returns
`{addonKey, targetAddonKey, project, effectiveAt}`.

Owner-only; requires a token minted with the billing scope. Start a
credit-pack top-up. Returns `{checkoutUrl, credits, eurCents}`.

get.summary: Endpoints under one line. 404 when the line key is unknown to this project.

post.summary: Creates an endpoint under a line. Body: the endpoint JSON document.

get.summary: The full JSON of one endpoint.

delete.summary: Deletes an endpoint and its targets.

patch.summary: Updates an endpoint. Body: a partial endpoint JSON document (PATCH merge).

post.summary:
Generates a draft endpoint under a line from a sample inbound request
and a description of the target. Body: `sample`,
`deliveryMode`, `draftRevision`, plus either `targetDocument` (an
OpenAPI 3.x document naming exactly one operation) and optionally
`targetFilename`, or `targetSample` with `targetUrl` (and optionally
`targetHttpMethod`). Always writes a draft, never publishes — publish it
through the line draft routes once reviewed.

get.summary:
OpenAPI / Swagger spec import is a web-only capability: the panel's
upload-and-preview wizard needs a human in a browser (CSRF + session),
so there is no machine import
path. Rather than let a programmatic client hit a bare 404, this route
answers with an explicit `web_only` error that names the panel and points
at the per-endpoint create route — the surface documents its own
exclusion instead of leaving a silent gap.

post.summary:
OpenAPI / Swagger spec import is a web-only capability: the panel's
upload-and-preview wizard needs a human in a browser (CSRF + session),
so there is no machine import
path. Rather than let a programmatic client hit a bare 404, this route
answers with an explicit `web_only` error that names the panel and points
at the per-endpoint create route — the surface documents its own
exclusion instead of leaving a silent gap.

get.summary:
Returns a canonical minimal-valid endpoint JSON for a fresh line —
agents can POST it verbatim to the create route and get an
immediately-working mock endpoint.

post.summary:
Validate an endpoint document without writing it. Pass `id` in the
URL to dry-run a PATCH against an existing endpoint; omit it to
dry-run a create. Returns {ok: true, resolved} or {ok: false, errors}.
post.description:
A `sample` in the body also evaluates every target's `outgoingMapping`
against it, and `answerSample` does the same for `answerMapping`,
attaching what each produced, which node produced each field, and every
rule that failed with the value that broke it. The payload never reaches
a vendor — it is handed to the mapping service, evaluated, and discarded.

get.summary: Lists the project's API keys (metadata only — never the plaintext).

post.summary: Mints a new key. Body: {name, mode, ttlDays?}. Returns the one-shot plaintext.
Manually mints a successor and links it. Returns the successor's plaintext.

One-shot plaintext retrieval for an auto-minted successor. Returns 410
when the secret has already been revealed (or was never stored, e.g.
post.description: a manually-rotated key) — the plaintext is genuinely unrecoverable.

get.summary: Returns the project's key policy.

put.summary: Owner-only: edits the project's key policy. Only fields present in the body are updated.

get.summary: The project's versioned API lines, with endpoint counts.

post.summary: Creates a line. Body: {name, lineKey}.

get.summary: The project's full relay configuration, as the relay itself reads it.

The change-gate preview: a structured diff between what a publish would
send right now (the frozen pending schedule if one exists, otherwise the
live draft) and the currently-published config.

post.summary: Deprecated: project-wide scheduling is retired. Always 410; use the per-line draft schedule route.

delete.summary: Deprecated: project-wide scheduling is retired. Always 410; use the per-line draft schedule route.

get.summary: Historical line revisions available for immediate rollback.

post.summary: Publish a retained line revision now; any pending schedule is cleared.

delete.summary: Deletes a line and everything under it.

post.summary:
Activate an inactive line so it serves traffic again. 409 when
the project is at its active-line cap — deactivate another first.
Stop a line serving, without deleting it — callers get 404. Idempotent.

Deep-copy a line and its endpoints/targets into a new line key — build
v2 from v1. The copy is saved inactive and does not serve until it is
activated. Body:
`{newLineKey, name?}`.

Set the line's public-docs flag. When enabled the line's
OpenAPI spec is published at `docs.{baseDomain}/{slug}/{lineKey}`.

get.summary:
Paginated request log. Mirrors the panel page and the
`list_requests` MCP tool. Accepts `status`, `method`, `path`, `since`,
`until`, `targetOutcome`, `limit`, `offset` as query args.

configVersion.description: Published config that authorised the request; 0 means unstamped.

get.summary:
Single request envelope + every per-target attempt, scoped to the
token's project. Returns 404 once the request has aged out of the
project's log-retention window.

200.description: One request and its per-target delivery attempts.

configVersion.description: Published config that authorised the request; 0 means unstamped.
Published config that authorised the delivery attempt; 0 means unstamped.

get.summary:
Every target this request fanned out to, each carrying its delivery
receipt or the reason it has none. A delivery still in flight answers
the same shape as a settled one. A sync/stream target carries
`reason: "sync_or_stream_delivery"` instead, since it completes inside
the caller's own HTTP response and never gets one. Mirrors the
`get_receipts` MCP tool.

200.description: Delivery receipts for one request, one entry per fanned-out target.

get.summary:
Aggregate activity metrics for the token's project. Mirrors the
`get_metrics` MCP tool. Query arg `window` ∈ hour|day|week|month (default
day); week/month require a paid plan and silently downgrade to day with
`planGated: true` otherwise. Optional `targetId` (slice over one outbound
target's per-attempt rows) or `endpointId` (one endpoint's inbound rows);
at most one of the two.

Paginated DLQ entries for this project, newest first. Mirrors
`list_dlq` MCP tool. Query: `limit`, `offset`.

configVersion.description: Published config that authorised the delivery; 0 means unstamped.

get.summary:
Every currently retained DLQ row for one inbound request. One request can
fan out to multiple targets and can have more than one retained row for
the same target, so `entries` is always a stream-row list.

200.description: Every retained dead-letter entry for one request.

id.description: Dead-letter entry id, of the form `{ms}-{seq}`. Changes whenever the entry is replayed and dead-letters again; prefer `requestId` to follow one request across replays.

get.summary: Single DLQ entry. 404 when no such stream id exists.

configVersion.description: Published config that authorised the delivery; 0 means unstamped.

delete.summary: Permanently delete a DLQ entry. Editor only.

post.summary: Re-enqueue a DLQ entry. 404 when already retried/discarded. Editor only.

get.summary:
Paginated audit-log read for this project, newest first. Mirrors
`list_audit_events` MCP tool. Query: `action`, `entityType`, `entityId`,
`since`, `until` (unix ms), `limit`, `offset`.
Project the token is scoped to: id, slug, name, caller-facing base URL, editAccess, scopes, burstOptIn, requestLogRetentionDays, auditRetentionDays.
List a project's tokens, any holder (account-scoped, `read` scope).
get.description: Metadata only — never a hash, never the plaintext.

post.summary:
Mint a project-scoped token for a project the user owns (account-scoped,
`config` scope). Body: `{label, scopes?, expiresInDays?}`.
post.description:
Attenuated by design: scopes are a subset of this token's own grant, the
expiry is mandatory and between 1 and 90 days, and a minted token can
never mint another. `spend` is never mintable here whatever the caller's
own scopes — it is granted from the panel only. Returns the plaintext
exactly once (201).

delete.summary:
Revoke a project-scoped token on an owned project (account-scoped,
`config` scope) — any holder's, the account-owner kill switch.
delete.description:
Soft-revoke, idempotent; a token that is not THIS project's is a 404
(doesn't confirm ids that exist elsewhere).
